zh.title: Meta 备受争议的网络抓取政策变更无限期推迟
zh.summary: Meta 于 2026 年 10 月上旬通报了商业使用条款的更新。根据新条款，在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 和 WhatsApp 上拥有企业帐户的公司和名人可以被视为已同意 Meta 抓取与这些帐户相关的网站，这引起了用户的批评。对此，Meta多次做出删除有关AI训练的描述、延长申请截止日期等修改，但2026年11月5日，Meta的商业中心更新，宣布商业使用条款的更新将无限期延长。

en.title: Meta's controversial web scraping policy change postponed indefinitely
en.summary: Meta notified of an update to the Commercial Terms of Use in early October 2026. Based on the new terms, companies and celebrities with business accounts on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and WhatsApp could be considered to have consented to Meta crawling the websites associated with those accounts, which drew criticism from users. In response to this, Meta has repeatedly made changes such as deleting the description regarding AI training and extending the application deadline, but on November 5, 2026, Meta's business center was updated and it was announced that the update of the commercial terms of use will be extended indefinitely.
